svg.title: Cello Tree scheme — recursive blob-nesting of C** particles
svg.text: ⌒ Cello Tree — the C** matter, cells within cells
every particle a blob cell · mainkey on the rim · sc rows inside · the .c stratum always shown · one crushed honesty mark
← flag-only: the key IS the value
crushed + dashed: a boundary the display chose, not the structure
same clay everywhere — one wall math (cello_blob wobble), one sc typography, one dim .c stratum
only the jewel colour names the kind
